title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit Rate Cut on PracticePay Payment Resets
content:
**Rule.** The FlexLine rate cut of a PracticePay Patient Financing payment reset reads every FlexLine the customer has held: when the customer holds an active FlexLine and no late fee and no returned payment were posted on any of the customer's FlexLines within the last 12 months, the cut is 1.00 percentage point; when the customer holds an active FlexLine and a returned payment but no late fee was posted on any of them within the last 12 months, the cut is 0.5 percentage points; in every other case the cut is 0; a window of the last N months here covering entries dated fewer than N whole months before the reset date, a month being whole once the reset date's day of the month has reached the entry's day of the month.

| Active FlexLine held | FlexLine entries, last 12 months | Rate cut (percentage points) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no late fee, no returned payment | 1.00 |
| yes | returned payment, no late fee | 0.5 |
| yes | a late fee | 0 |
| no | anything | 0 |

The FlexLines read are all of the customer's lines under FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit; an active FlexLine is one whose status on Larkspur's records is active.
